expectation: Cytoplasmic, granular stain in a distinct subset of cells (macrophages and monocytes), scattered as single cells or clusters among tumour and stroma. It should be dimmer on dendritic cells and some fibroblasts, and it should overlap CD163 partly.
observed: A: discrete yellow cells scattered across most cores, with dense clusters in some. B/C: sparse cell-shaped yellow cells on dim nuclei, with no haze. D: bright granular cytoplasm around nuclei. E: CD68 cells sit on or beside CD163 cells, and some are CD68-only.
why: CD68 marks a distinct, cell-shaped, granular subset that partly overlaps CD163 and shows no haze or edge artefact.
